release_notes: Build 192 makes the Performance Diagnostics hotspot profiler registration deterministic when the diagnostics page is created.
Build 192 removes the previous button-loaded registration approach that could still miss the lazily created diagnostics page.
Build 192 keeps the profiler registration off the normal startup path and only attaches it when Performance Diagnostics results are loaded.
Performance Diagnostics continues to measure navigation, memory, allocations, and garbage collection behavior.
